name: sunoforge
description: AI music prompt orchestrator: ready-to-paste prompts, lyrics markup, speech scripts, prompt repair, rights and post-production for Suno v6 and Suno Speech, Google Lyria 3.5, Flow Music, ElevenMusic, Stable Audio, MiniMax and local models. Sends a blueprint to any music-generation MCP the session shows, Suno's included, only after you say yes. Works in any language the user writes in.

library_dir.title: Folder for your SunoForge data
library_dir.description: Optional: your own folder for settings.md and library.md, e.g. D:\SunoForge. It survives uninstalling or updating the plugin. Leave empty for the plugin's data folder, deleted on uninstall.

language.title: SunoForge language
language.description: Menus and answers in this language; auto follows the language you write in. Typing set lang in the chat overrides it.
